raw_segments.text: And Gilo, tease so, and that self-chain about his neck which he forswore most monstrously
Good, sir, draw near to me, I'll speak to him.
Signior Antifolus, I wonder much that you would put me to this shame and trouble, and
not without some scandal to yourself, with circumstance and oath so to deny this chain,
which now you wear so openly.
Beside the charge, the shame, imprisonment, you have done wrong to this my honest friend,
who, but for staying on our controversy, had hoisted sail and put to sea today.
This chain you had of me, can you deny it?
